description: Events across EVERY account at once, in time order, for a window: today and the next days by default. Also returns `conflicts` (busy events that overlap, including across accounts, e.g. a work meeting over a dentist appointment), `probableDuplicates` (one appointment booked into both accounts as two events) and `pendingInvites` (invitations not yet answered). Recurring events are expanded into their instances; an event seen through both accounts is listed once, with `alsoOn`. Declined events are left out unless asked for. Each event carries the account, calendarId and eventId that get_event, update_event, delete_event and respond_to_invite need. include_tasks adds `tasksDue`: the Google Tasks not yet done that fall due on the window's days (a task has a due date, never a time).

account.description: Which account: a label from list_accounts, or "*" for every account at once (the default).

calendars.description: "selected" (what the Calendar app shows, the default), "primary" (each account's own calendar only), "all", or a list of calendar ids or names.

days.description: Window length when `to` is empty; at most 366.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD or a time. Empty means today (UTC).

include_tasks.description: Also the open tasks due on these days, from the same accounts' Google Tasks.

query.description: Free-text search over title, description, location and guests.

to.description: Exclusive end. Empty means `days` after from.
